examples.from: by ten to eleven a m

families.normalized: the same rule over a NORMALIZATION FLOOR -- a filler the projection does not move is still emitted case-folded with whitespace collapsed, which is the corpus's own surface convention and needs no inventory at all
families.rule: the committed rule alone: a filler the projection does not move keeps its own bytes

paired_settings.delta: projected - baseline, on per-sample official scores

relock_rule_if_taken: the comparator's slot arm becomes the sealed KC-S1b rows PLUS slurp-value-projection-v1 at threshold 0.35 in family 'normalized', scored through a registered scorer id that applies it between the parse and the official prediction file -- the exact shape slurp-slu-official-projected-v2 already has for labels. OWNER GO REQUIRED; this read does not re-lock anything

rule.statement: project a predicted slot filler onto the nearest TRAIN surface form OF THE SAME SLOT TYPE when the official scorer's own normalized character distance is at or below the threshold; the comparison string is the prediction case-folded with whitespace collapsed, ties break on the larger TRAIN mention count then lexicographically, and the rule never changes a slot type, invents a filler, or deletes a prediction
